title: Symmetry of Solutions to Fractional Semilinear Equations on Hyperbolic Spaces
summary: We study a semilinear equation involving the fractional Laplacian on the hyperbolic space $\mathbb{H}^n$. Unlike in conformally compact Einstein manifolds, the fractional Laplacian on $\mathbb{H}^n$ does not enjoy conformal covariance. By employing Helgason-Fourier analysis, we explicitly derive the Green's function of the fractional Laplacian on $\mathbb{H}^n$ as well as its asymptotic behaviors.
